Definition: to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside
BiblicalUsage: 1) to loosen, abide, begin; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to loosen; 1a2) to abide (from loosing girths for camp); 1b) (Pael) to begin, open; 1c) (Ithpael) to be loosened
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
